newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower in holiday mode, hedging.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower in holiday mode, hedging.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower in quiet trading ahead of the three-day holiday weekend with producer hedge selling also weighing on prices, traders said.
"It was a holiday trade with hedge selling noted," a trader said.
Markets will be closed Monday due to the U.S. Labor Day holiday.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 200 contracts, down from 457 Thursday, according to the CBOT. Rice options volume was estimated at 10 contracts, down from 79 Thursday.
Rice futures closed 5-1/2 to seven cents per cwt lower, with September down six at $10.30.
